d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how, a year after the United States designated Nigeria as a Country of Particular Concern due to alleged severe religious freedom violations, top State Department officials report that violence against Christian communities remains high. Testifying before Congress, US lawmakers acknowledged that Abuja has introduced new security initiatives, including increased police hiring and joint working groups, but stressed these measures have failed to deliver tangible safety on the ground, particularly in the volatile Middle Belt.
